entries.source: E. Curzel and G. M. Varanini (eds.), La documentazione dei vescovi di Trento (XI secolo–1218), Bologna 2011; Document 68
entries.english: At Bolzano, Egno of Eppan/Appiano conveys Castelvecchio and related holdings to Bishop Conrad of Trento, who grants the castle back under stated feudal terms. Henricus de Resebacho occurs in the witness list.
